assumptions.statement: Overall design and key-area polygons are provisional_rough organizer substitutes, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive metrics must be recomputed after official geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: Station halls, platforms, and pilgrimage landmarks are conceptual urban-design suggestions for professional deepening.
assumptions.impact: No demolition, investment, or approval claims are made.

assumptions.statement: Metric areas are computed after projecting WGS84 polygons to EPSG:4548.
assumptions.impact: Small residual topology differences may appear if a different projection is used.
